# llmsurgery

> LLM Surgery

## Modules

- [llmsurgery.agy](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/agy.html.md): Read, search, and compact Antigravity conversations
- [llmsurgery.ant](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/ant.html.md): Read, search, and edit Claude Code sessions. Compact conversations and recover prompt history.
- [llmsurgery.mirror](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/mirror.html.md): Convert Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity transcripts to dialog notebooks for searching, reading, and archiving conversations
- [llmsurgery.oai](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/oai.html.md): Read, write, and build Codex session rollouts
- [llmsurgery.sess](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/llmsurgery/sess.html.md): Find, read, and compact a session from any supported host
- `llmsurgery.skill`: Read and work with Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity session transcripts.
